title: A Gentle Watch Over the Night

sentences.text: The parents' room stayed below 18.0 °C all night, reaching 17.4 °C at 01:00.
The living room also stayed below 18.0 °C from 01:40 to 06:00, with the coldest time being 05:50.
Since both rooms stayed below 18.0 °C, please remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Because of the cold temperatures shown in C1 and C2, perhaps checking the heating would be a gentle idea.
